# Changelog

All notable changes to this agent will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [1.0.0] - 2026-01-12

### Added
- Initial production release
- Core agent functionality with full CRUD operations
- Pytest failure output parser with regex-based pattern matching
- AST-based code analyzer for implementation inspection
- Fix generator for string format, data structure, and type change mismatches
- Hypothesis-based fix validator for property-based testing
- Comprehensive configuration support via YAML
- Unit and integration test suite (21+ tests, ≥90% coverage)
- CLI interface for analyze and fix commands
- Cognitive brain integration for pattern storage
- Documentation and usage examples
- Standard agent structure compliance

### Features
- Automatic detection of assertion mismatches from pytest output
- Intelligent classification of mismatch types (string_format, data_structure, type_change)
- Context-aware fix generation preserving test intent
- Validation of fixes before application
- Auto-commit with detailed explanations
- Integration with GitHub Actions workflows
- Monitoring and metrics collection
- Security-first design with sandboxed execution

### Configuration
- Configurable timeout and retry settings
- Alert thresholds for validation failure rates
- Cognitive brain pattern learning enabled
- GitHub integration for PR comments and status checks

### Security
- Sandboxed code execution
- File access limited to test files only
- No network access required
- Never accesses secrets or sensitive data

### Documentation
- Comprehensive README with usage examples
- Detailed prompt templates (main, examples, advanced)
- Agent configuration schema
- Integration guide with CI/CD pipelines

### Testing
- 21+ unit tests covering core functionality
- Integration tests for end-to-end workflows
- Property-based testing examples
- Test coverage ≥90%

### Known Limitations
- Requires manual review for breaking API changes
- Best suited for internal API evolution, not external contracts
- Validation requires pytest and hypothesis dependencies

### Future Enhancements
- Support for additional test frameworks (unittest, nose2)
- Machine learning for pattern recognition
- Auto-detection of breaking vs. non-breaking changes
- Enhanced error message analysis
- Multi-file fix orchestration
